interpretation.daily_bar_observed_at: ICE historical chart stores day only, not a verified official settlement timestamp; absent observed_at is not fabricated.
interpretation.price_type: ICE public chart remains reference with verified=false. The known daily reference is eligible only for conditional same-contract comparison, never official settlement scoring.
interpretation.refresh_gate: market_refresh_reason returns no update when market_baseline.available=false; a newly valid daily anchor alone does not make an old/stale intraday quote fresh.
